name: Armchair
summary: This armchair is a typical example of furniture made during the Ming dynasty (1368-1644). Its beauty lies in the simplicity of form, the high quality of the wood, and the meticulous craftsmanship. It is constructed entirely of mortise-and-tenon joints and without the use of nails.
